description: Splits a note and gate pair into 48 separate gate outputs, one per semitone, sending the gate to the output whose printed note number matches the note at CV

inputs.text: The note voltage choosing which output the gate goes to, one volt per octave with 0V selecting the jack printed 60; a polyphonic cable is read channel by channel
The gate or trigger sent on to the chosen output; its voltage is copied through unchanged, so whatever height arrives here is the height that leaves the output

outputs.text: Carries the Gate/Trig voltage while the note at CV is 35, and also whenever that note falls outside the range printed on the panel, because the note search returns this output when it matches nothing
Carries the Gate/Trig voltage while the note at CV is the number printed beside this jack, and 0V otherwise
Nothing in the module ever drives this output; the note search stops one note short, so note 82 fires the jack printed 35 and this jack stays at 0V, despite the panel printing 82 beside it

notes: nothing appears at any output until cables are patched to both CV and Gate/Trig; with either one missing every output stays at 0V.
the lamp above each jack is lit in proportion to the voltage at that jack.
a polyphonic cable at CV gives each channel its own output, so several outputs can be high at once; the output jacks themselves are mono.
the outputs run from the bottom left of the grid upwards, following the note numbers printed down the left-hand side.

inputs.0:
1V per octave · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V.
